description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier that displays an alert prompting the user to run an OpenClaw agent, based on a deep link prompt stored in the application's environment model. It also includes an extension to the View protocol to easily attach this prompt alert modifier.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPromptAlert
classes.description: A ViewModifier that presents an alert for confirming the execution of an OpenClaw agent based on a deep link prompt.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the view content, integrating an alert bound to a prompt in the environment model.
